pick.title: Insurers say AI could add billions in health costs. Billing companies disagree
pick.headline: Insurers Say Billing AI Will Raise Costs; Billing Companies Say It Won't
pick.take: Insurers say AI will drive health costs up. The companies selling AI billing tools say it will drive costs down. Both have a financial stake in being right, and neither number comes with a citation. The physician who has to document the visit either way was not asked.
